what_it_allows: Everything USER_ADMIN does across the company, plus company settings, creating User Admins and other owners, approving sensitive access grants; final approver when nobody else exists. Sees every report in the company, read-only (totals, never single rows), and every outlet's licences and compliance calendar. The last owner cannot be removed.

meant_for: Delegated user administrator (company or one outlet)
what_it_allows: Add, edit, deactivate users; assign job roles and extra access; reset passwords, within their scope. Gives no access to business data. Creating another User Admin needs owner approval.

Own shifts, attendance, leave, swaps, notifications, own pay rate (view); their own tasks; reports maintenance problems where they work; their own clock-in selfie Reads the SOPs for their place and role and confirms "I've read this" (Training, ADR 095).

Views the roster of the place it is given and the events of its outlet; reads the recipes and prep procedures of the store linked to their department (no costs); sees their department's maintenance queue Writes in the logbook and the registers, records breakage and linen sent to and back from the laundry where they work (ADR 089, 090, 093, 094).

Views roster and attendance of their department; reads the recipes and procedures of their department's store; gives and manages tasks in their department and reads its checklists As STAFF for the logbook, registers, breakage and linen; reads meter readings, audit scores and training (ADR 089 to 095).

Builds and publishes the department roster; resolves attendance exceptions; first approval of leave and swaps; views the outlet's events; reads the recipes, prices and costs of their department's store; gives and manages tasks, edits checklists, and assigns maintenance requests and expired-batch discards in their department; sees the clock-in selfies and new or shared phone flags of their department; approves unusual orders and requests for material (off the menu or more than usual) Keeps the department's logbook, registers, breakage, linen, meters, audits and training sessions (ADR 089 to 095).

meant_for: Cooks and bartenders who make prep items
what_it_allows: Records production batches at the store linked to their department, for prep items made there; no stock, count, wastage, order or transfer access
Creates and edits events for the whole outlet: covers, items and staff needed

meant_for: Heads of kitchen and service departments
what_it_allows: Writes today's briefing note for the shift at their department: specials, dishes that are off today, guests to know about, targets; everyone who works at the outlet reads it on Home

meant_for: Housekeeping and front office of a hotel
what_it_allows: Checks and refills the rooms' minibars from their store, and marks what was added to the guest's bill (ADR 072) Keeps each room's status and contents, and breakfast by room (Rooms, ADR 088, 094).
Imports the POS's end-of-day sales file for the outlet; sees nothing of its sales, costs or reports

meant_for: A commis, in the department's store
what_it_allows: Opens packs with a shelf life once opened and prints their use-by labels, and sees the packs open there; no other stock access (Shelf life & labels, ADR 093, 097)

Views stock, records counts and wastage, requests transfers, for that store only; reads the recipes and procedures made or sold at that store; records production batches of prep items made there Opens packs and prints their use-by labels (Shelf life & labels, ADR 093).

Everything STOCK_USER does, plus raises and receives purchase orders and dispatches internal transfers; reads recipes made or sold at the store (no prices or costs); records production; told when sales take stock below zero; sees which items were verified in the stock check and by whom; adds the bill to an order it receives and records bills for services at its store Opens packs and prints their labels; keeps the store's excise register, FLR and transport permits (ADR 093, 096).

Views stock, counts, wastage and purchase orders across all stores of the outlet (no stock changes, except the stock check below); recipes, prices, cost per serve and cost % of the outlet; posts daily sales; variance and food and beverage cost %; verifies stock: counts each store blind, adds a photo to each difference, and the difference posts at once; reads every vendor bill of the outlet's stores Reads opened packs and the excise register and FLR (ADR 093, 096).

meant_for: Verifies stock where the company has no Cost Controller (given by the Account Owner)
what_it_allows: Views stock levels and does the stock check at the stores it is given: counts blind, adds a photo to each difference, and the difference posts at once; no other stock changes
Maintains worker records and leave for the outlet; sees clock-in selfies Keeps training sessions, attendance and scores, and sees who has read each SOP (ADR 095).

meant_for: Head of an outlet (GM, or Bar Manager of a standalone bar)
what_it_allows: Everything in the outlet across all departments and stores; approves purchase orders and escalations; menu costs, and changes menus, prices and recipes used only within the outlet; records production and posts daily sales; gives and manages tasks, edits checklists and assigns maintenance across the outlet; sees which items were verified in the stock check and by whom; told of every order and can approve unusual ones; sees and records every vendor bill of the outlet; sees phone flags but not selfies; keeps the outlet's licences and compliance calendar when Compliance is in the plan; writes the outlet's briefing note for the shift; checks the rooms' minibars Keeps every new block at the outlet: logbook, registers, meters, audits, training, breakage, opened packs, excise, rooms and linen (ADR 087 to 096).

meant_for: Oversees all outlets in an area
what_it_allows: Views everything in the area, including linked stores (read-only); approves large purchase orders and escalations; menu costs across the area (view only); views tasks, checklists and maintenance across the area; sees the area's licences and compliance calendar and the rooms' minibars Reads the outlets' logbooks, registers, meters, audits, training, breakage, rooms and linen (ADR 089 to 095).

Manages stock at the central kitchen store and dispatches transfers to outlets (that store only); recipes and costs of what the central kitchen makes; records production at the central kitchen; sees which items were verified in the stock check and by whom; reads the central kitchen's vendor bills Opens packs and prints their labels at the hub (ADR 093).
Views stock in every store below the place it is given (no changes)

meant_for: An accountant, at the outlet's stores
what_it_allows: Reads the vendor bills and the orders of the outlet's stores, and so the purchasing report (price changes, supplier fill rate); no stock levels, counts or changes (ADR 109)

meant_for: Someone other than the manager who keeps the licences (an accountant or admin executive)
what_it_allows: Adds, corrects and renews the outlet's licences and keeps its compliance calendar, with their documents (when Compliance is in the plan)
Worker records, pay rates, leave across the company; sees clock-in selfies Keeps training sessions, attendance and scores across the company (ADR 095).
Approves sensitive role changes; reads the audit log
Reads the audit log only
